wiki.title: Adrielle Camuel
wiki.extract: Adrielle C. Camuel (born May 26, 1972) is an American politician from Kentucky. She is a Democrat and represents District 93 in the state house. Camuel represents southern Lexington and works as a support professional in Fayette County schools. She received a bachelor's and master's degree from the University of Louisville.
